verdict.rationale: Ultrametric documents an npm one-liner for the CLI and an `ultrametric init` command that writes skill files for Codex and Claude Code. A keyless dry-run probe confirmed it targets `.agents/skills/ultrametric/SKILL.md` and `.claude/skills/ultrametric/SKILL.md`. Setup takes two steps (install the CLI, then run init), and the docs never state that the skill becomes active in the next session. missing for 10: a single-command install, documented next-session activation, a hands-on run of the actual write (only the dry run was recorded), and evidence that a multi-skill collection is installed rather than a single SKILL.md.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install a skill collection with one documented command — a package-manager one-liner, CLI, or in-agent marketplace command — and it is active in my next session

citations.quote: The first command previews changes. The second writes the selected skill files.
The CLI can add Ultrametric instructions to a project for Codex and Claude Code.
